headline: Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. Discloses Cyberattack, Halts Operations
body: Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd., a leading automotive components supplier, has revealed a cyberattack that has forced the company to take immediate action. The attack led to the isolation of several servers and a temporary halt in production and order-processing systems across its facilities. The perpetrators have issued a ransom demand, prompting Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. to engage cybersecurity incident responders. The company is working diligently to restore affected systems and resume normal operations.
